title: Caddie Combo+
body_html:
The ultimate on-course combo. The Caddie gives you complete course intelligence with maps, greens heat maps, slope-adjusted distances, scoring, and stats, while the Prism+ locks onto the flag with fast, precise yardages.

Together, they eliminate guesswork, cut out distractions, and keep you completely dialed in every round.

title: Caddie GPS Smart Tablet
body_html:
Every pro has a caddie. Now you do too.

Full hole GPS, smart yardages, scoring, and games on an 8" weatherproof tablet that lives on your cart. 45,000+ courses built in. No cell service or wifi needed. PGA Show Best New Product for a reason.

title: Dart 2.0 Speaker
body_html: The Dart 2.0 packs upgraded sound and smarter design into our most portable golf speaker yet. With a stronger magnet, detachable carabiner, and over 10 hours of battery life, it’s built to clip, stick, and play wherever your round takes you. Dialed-in audio meets all-day durability, because good vibes should last 18 holes and beyond.

body_html: Turn your golf experience up a notch with The Sound Stick! The perfect speaker for golf lovers looking to unleash their inner DJ out on the course. The Sound Stick comes in 6 different colors, has a built-in magnet and a battery that lasts 15+ hours! Better Music. Better Vibes. Better Golf.

title: Stick Kit
body_html:
Get dialed in while turning up the vibes.

The Prism+ delivers fast, dialed in yardages with first-target acquisition and slope-adjusted distance, so you get numbers you can trust.

The Sound Stick brings the energy with powerful, crystal-clear audio that allows you to turn up the vibes all round long.

title: Stick Kit PRO
body_html: Two of our best sellers, bundled to keep you dialed in all round long. The Prism+ delivers fast, precise distances with our most advanced rangefinder technology yet, while the Sound Stick PRO pairs with the Pinned App to bring crystal-clear sound, real-time yardages, and on-course insights to every round. Together, they help you play smarter, sound better, and have more fun on the course.

title: The Roller
body_html:
Upgrade your at-home practice with The Roller Putting Mat, a 9-foot indoor golf putting mat designed to deliver true roll, consistent speed, and real feedback on every stroke. Whether you’re grinding in the office, dialing it in at home, or getting extra reps during the offseason, the Roller turns any room into your personal practice green.

In collaboration with the original founders of Perfect Practice.
